verdict.rationale: The Honeycomb API explicitly supports programmatic management of triggers, SLOs, queries, datasets and environments, so alerts can be provisioned as code via the API. A downloadable OpenAPI spec supports building tooling on top of it. Boards (dashboards) are documented only as a UI workspace with pre-configured templates, not as API-managed or JSON-defined objects, and there is no evidence of a Terraform provider. Missing for 10: evidence of Boards/dashboards managed via API or JSON models, a Terraform provider or IaC workflow, documented repeatable provisioning patterns, and independent hands-on corroboration.
